observation: The DAL@ARI line FLIPPED in the five minutes between the owner's two captures.
effect_on_the_registered_benchmark: The benchmark registered at 01:04Z took ARI as the CAPTURE-TIME favourite, which was correct at that moment. It is a capture-time benchmark by construction and is NOT revised to chase the move. The move itself is recorded here as separate evidence.
note: A full favourite flip on a preseason game 55 minutes before kickoff is the kind of movement that makes a single capture-time benchmark fragile. Worth carrying into any future NFL benchmark design; not acted on tonight.
